title: Delegated access token claims
description: The claims of the token that `exchangeAppUserToken` (runtime API) returns: the app acts for the signed-in user (docs/DESIGN.md section 9.4) against the runtime API and the internal gateway at `ruum.internal`, never against the REST API or another app's origin. A JWT (EdDSA, the workload-token keys). The effective right of every call is the user's right intersected with the named bindings. Valid for 5 minutes, not renewable. Apps never parse it: they send it as `Authorization: Bearer` to `ruum.internal`. Unknown claims are ignored by the platform (contracts/apps/README.md). DRAFT for review (step 3 specify phase, docs/STEP3.md).

iss.description: The origin of the Ruum instance.

sub.description: The app principal that asked: the app node ID (live) or the deployment ID (preview).

act.description: The actor of every write made with this token: the app.

on_behalf_of.description: The platform user ID that the user token named (resolved from its pairwise `sub`; never shown to the app). Every write records it.

agent.description: When the user token's `actor` was `agent`: the agent, whose scope also limits every call.

chain.description: The apps of a delegation chain (design 9.10), oldest first.

bindings.description: The binding names this token may use: those with `on_behalf_of_user` (node bindings) or `delegate` (API bindings).
